cues.text: You're the queen of the country and I'm a servant of yours
cues.translation: 너는 이 나라의 여왕 나는 네 하인

cues.text: We were twins right from the start that from fate got torn apart
cues.translation: 우린 태어날 때부터 운명에 갈라진 쌍둥이

cues.text: I will try to protect you from everything that hurts
cues.translation: 널 아프게 하는 모든 걸 막아낼게

cues.text: And I'll do as you'll say, even the evil way
cues.translation: 네가 바라면 악한 길도 따를게

cues.text: Born into a world where everyone expected the best
cues.translation: 모두가 최고를 바라던 세상에 태어나

cues.text: Blessed by all the bells that rang up in the high without rest
cues.translation: 하늘 높이 쉬지 않고 울린 종의 축복을 받았지

cues.text: But our parents planned just how we'd be of very best use
cues.translation: 부모님은 우릴 가장 쓸모 있게 만들려 했고

cues.text: Then they split our future in two, there was nothing we could do
cues.translation: 우리 미래를 둘로 갈랐어 어쩔 수 없었지

cues.text: If the world is vile and you make it your foe
cues.translation: 세상이 사악해 네가 맞서 싸운다면

cues.text: There is just one thing that I want you to know
cues.translation: 네게 꼭 알려주고 싶은 말이 하나 있어

cues.text: I'll protect you and I will do as you please
cues.translation: 널 지키고 네 뜻대로 할게

cues.text: So you'll smile, feel happy and be at peace
cues.translation: 네가 웃고 행복하고 평안하도록

cues.text: And I'll do as you'll say, even the evil way
cues.translation: 네가 바라면 악한 길도 따를게

cues.text: Then one day I went down to the nation next to our own
cues.translation: 그러던 어느 날 나는 이웃 나라로 갔어

cues.text: There I saw a girl in green, she caught my hat that had flown
cues.translation: 그곳에서 초록 옷 소녀가 날아간 내 모자를 잡았어

cues.text: With her gentle soothing voice and tender welcoming smile
cues.translation: 다정하고 포근한 목소리와 반기는 미소에

cues.text: I could only stand and stare, I just fell in love right there
cues.translation: 그저 넋 놓고 바라보다 그 자리에서 사랑에 빠졌어

cues.text: But the queen has one wish that needs to be fulfilled
cues.translation: 하지만 여왕에게는 이루어야 할 소원이 있어

cues.text: That the girl should die even if her blood is spilled
cues.translation: 그 소녀가 피를 흘려도 죽어야 한다는 것

cues.text: I shall answer back to the wish that she speaks
cues.translation: 네가 말한 그 소원에 따를게

cues.text: Without clue why my tears here are falling down my cheeks
cues.translation: 왜인지도 모른 채 눈물이 뺨을 타고 흘러

cues.text: I will serve you this brioche, I'm sure you'll like the taste
cues.translation: 이 브리오슈를 드릴게 분명 맛있어할 거야

cues.text: And you'll smile with no blame, but soon it won't be the same
cues.translation: 넌 탓하지 않고 웃겠지만 곧 달라질 거야

cues.text: Very soon this kingdom ends with everything that you were
cues.translation: 머지않아 네 모든 것과 함께 이 왕국은 끝나

cues.text: Cause of all the people that will chase you with their anger
cues.translation: 분노한 모든 이들이 널 쫓을 테니까

cues.text: Retribution is what they are calling what they will do
cues.translation: 그들은 저들이 할 일을 응징이라 부르겠지

cues.text: But I bet they never knew I will always try to save you
cues.translation: 하지만 내가 늘 널 구하려 한다는 건 몰라

cues.text: Come and take my clothes, this is the way that you can go
cues.translation: 내 옷을 가져가 이 길로 떠날 수 있어

cues.text: You shall wear them till you're gone and they won't ever know
cues.translation: 네가 떠날 때까지 입고 있어 아무도 모를 거야

cues.text: It is fine, we're twins and I will be here when they strike
cues.translation: 괜찮아 우린 쌍둥이니까 그들이 덮칠 때 내가 여기 있을게

cues.text: They won't know you are gone all because we look alike
cues.translation: 우리가 닮아서 네가 떠난 걸 아무도 모를 거야

cues.text: I'm the queen of the country and you're a runaway
cues.translation: 나는 이 나라의 여왕 너는 도망자야

cues.translation: 우린 태어날 때부터 운명에 갈라진 쌍둥이

cues.text: If they're calling you evil, I know someone like you
cues.translation: 네가 악하다고 불린다면 난 너 같은 이를 알아

cues.text: I am evil, I take blame, cause our blood is just the same
cues.translation: 내가 악해 내가 죄를 짊어질게 우리 피는 같으니까

cues.text: Once upon a time there were two very happy twins
cues.translation: 옛날 옛적 아주 행복한 쌍둥이 두 명이 있었어

cues.text: One of them she was the queen and there the story begins
cues.translation: 그중 한 명은 여왕이었고 이야기는 거기서 시작돼

cues.text: She was sitting at the top and she used to reign
cues.translation: 그녀는 높은 곳에 앉아 나라를 다스렸지

cues.text: She was always very cute, but the kingdom it was brute
cues.translation: 언제나 아주 귀여웠지만 그 왕국은 잔혹했어

cues.text: When the bells are ringing the queen stands to weep
cues.translation: 종이 울리면 여왕은 서서 눈물을 흘려

cues.text: She is wishing that just sometime again they will meet
cues.translation: 언젠가 다시 만날 수 있기를 바라면서
